This '''individual''' was a [[Theelin]] [[Gender|male]] who worked as a [[Technician|mechanic]] and was held captive on [[Freighter 2716]] by the [[Galactic Empire]] to work on a secret project. They were freed from captivity by a group of rebels and joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Name of the Rebellion" />
